quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE named a Leader in 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE says GreenLake supports approximately 52,000 customers, reflecting continued expansion in adoption and capabilities. Over the past year HPE expanded GreenLake with agentic AIOps and unified cloud operations software: HPE CloudOps Software unifies HPE Morpheus Software, HPE OpsRamp Software and HPE Zerto Software capabilities in one stack, and is positioned to observe, govern and optimize enterprise AI factories and agentic workloads (including managing token consumption and costs). GreenLake can be deployed within customers' own environments and through managed service providers. The release announces HPE was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Infrastructure Platform Consumption Services for the second consecutive year (an analyst recognition). No revenue or order figures stated.
